# Patrick Koorevaar

> Patrick Koorevaar is a senior Azure DevOps Engineer working with AKS, Azure Container Apps (ACA) and CI/CD pipelines. Running production AKS and CI/CD by day, and shipping live LLM applications on Cloudflare Workers AI as side projects.
